About me

I'm Thomas, a Computer Science and Applied Mathematics & Statistics student at Johns Hopkins, passionate about designing software that drives meaningful change. I'm especially excited to explore how machine learning and AI can be applied to imaging analysis and processing.

I was born in Shanghai and spent most of my childhood in Vancouver, where I fell for aviation, from designing and building gliders to piloting Cessnas over the city's downtown. In my spare time, I enjoy playing the piano and tenor saxophone, skiing, and travelling.
